verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM runs AI agents, custom agent skills and MCP tools, so per-action approval of dangerous actions is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents none of the story's elements: no command allowlists, no approval prompts, and no opt-in elevated modes. The 'fine-grained admin controls' and 'configure permissions' claims cover user and role access, an adjacent control that earns no credit here.
